name: Synthflow
tagline: No-code platform for AI voice agents that automate phone calls.
description: Synthflow is an enterprise voice-AI platform for building and deploying AI agents that handle phone calls — inbound and outbound — without code. A visual flow designer, in-house telephony, real-time monitoring, and 200+ integrations across calendars, CRMs, and telephony let teams stand up agents for customer service, appointment scheduling, and lead qualification. It runs on a pay-as-you-go model: build and test free, then pay per call once live.
insight: Raised a $20M Series A led by Accel in 2025; its voice agents have handled 45M+ calls to date.

modelSupport.notes: Choose from multiple LLM and TTS providers when configuring an agent.

edge: Tuned for high-volume contact-center phone automation, with a choice of LLM and TTS providers per agent.
pros: Pay-as-you-go, free to build and test
cons: Focused on phone/voice, not broad chat
Advanced features gated to higher tiers

references.title: Synthflow AI: $20M Secured for Voice AI Phone Automation
